card.name: Inside new brand drug names
card.fires_on: The 'Z'-type piece in the middle of newly approved brand or generic drug names, such as VOQUE-Z-NA, OMCA-Z-IO, NAGLA-ZY-ME. It also fires in names like rilz-ab-rutinib and freman-ez-umab.

modes.label: Brand names with Z

card.writes: It pushes toward approval words such as approved, approval and drugs, which fits newly approved drug names.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of unusual new drug names, especially brand names with a Z in them.
